[EVENT] User is planning a team-building event for their department.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of ten engaging and fun team-building activities, including an escape room challenge, cooking competition, scavenger hunt, volunteer day, game show, outdoor activities, creative project, wine and painting night, mystery dinner, and karaoke night.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided simple scavenger hunt ideas that require minimal resources, including office supply scavenger hunt, photo scavenger hunt, word scavenger hunt, nature scavenger hunt, and desk scavenger hunt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered tips for organizing a simple scavenger hunt, such as keeping the list short, setting a time limit, dividing the team into small groups, and designating a meeting point.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of the office supply scavenger hunt because it is easy to organize and relatable for everyone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of items for the office supply scavenger hunt, including a stapler, pen with blue ink, yellow highlighter, pack of post-it notes, paperclip, binder clip, roll of Scotch tape, desk calendar, notebook with a specific color cover, and pack of folders with labels.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant included unique office items and office-themed challenges for the scavenger hunt.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to add a twist to the scavenger hunt by asking teams to come up with a creative way to use each item they find.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant praised the user's idea of adding a creative element to the scavenger hunt and highlighted the benefits of encouraging creative thinking, fostering collaboration, adding humor, and making the game memorable.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of giving out prizes for the most creative use of each item and a grand prize for the team that comes up with the most creative uses overall.
